summary.text: Benjamin Chafetz is the Republican candidate for Idaho State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Carrie Semmelroth (D).
His career experience includes working as an engineer.

paragraphs.text: Benjamin Chafetz was born in Silver Spring, Maryland, and earned a high school diploma from Winston Churchill High School, a bachelor's degree from Western Carolina University in 2011 and a bachelor's degree from Boise State University in 2018.
Chafetz was the Republican candidate for Idaho State Senate District 17 in 2022, when incumbent Carrie Semmelroth defeated him, 59.8 percent to 40.2 percent.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he wanted to keep the legislature accessible and transparent and to limit spending and taxation.
